name: Chromatic Orrery
oracle_text:
You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color.
{T}: Add {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
{5}, {T}: Draw a card for each color among permanents you control.
blocked_sentences: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color.

needs.what: a player-wide static -- e.g. `spend_mana_as_any_color` with `affects_player: "you"` -- that makes every coloured pip in every cost that player pays payable with mana of any colour, for as long as the permanent printing it is on the battlefield. It is the unrestricted, always-on version of the permission `ManaCost.as_any_color()` already implements: it has to be read at the same places `player_pays_life_for_black` is (the cast line in `casting._cast_variant` and `Game._cast`, and `costs.can_pay` / `costs.pay` for activated abilities, suspend, equip and every other cost), so the mana solver plans against the loosened cost rather than the printed one -- and it must apply to abilities and to spells cast from every zone, not only to cards the card itself made playable.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest existing thing is `black_mana_as_phyrexian`, the one player-wide static that alters how costs are *paid* (K'rrik, via `player_statics.player_pays_life_for_black` and `ManaCost.black_as_phyrexian`); it rewrites {B} pips into Phyrexian ones and has no colour-loosening form, and nothing else in `static_effects` touches payment -- `add_mana_on_tap` and `double_land_mana` change what mana is *produced*, not what it may be spent on. The engine's any-colour payment already exists as `ManaCost.as_any_color()`, but it is reachable only through `permission.playable_any_color`: the `any_color` flag on `exile` / `grant_playable` / `look_at_top` / `search_library`, which attaches to specific cards a specific effect made playable ("you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it" -- Elder Brain). Chromatic Orrery grants no playability at all, so there is no card for that flag to ride on, and it loosens every cost the controller ever pays, activated abilities included. Approximating with a mana ability that adds any colour is a different card: the printed {T} ability makes exactly {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}, and the static also fixes the colourless mana produced by lands and by other permanents the Orrery never taps.
